title: Majestic 12 / MAJI named in an NRO document

tellings.quote: Oh, it used to be called Majestic 12. The last I know it's been the last good name I can pinpoint on a document from the 90s from the NRO national reconnaissance office was uh magic

plain: A researcher named Steven Greer, on Jesse Michels's podcast, talks about the secret group he says controls the UFO secrets. According to Greer, it used to be called Majestic 12, and the latest name he can point to is something like "Magic" (MAJI), which he says he saw on a 1990s document from the NRO, the National Reconnaissance Office, the US agency that runs spy satellites. If true, it would mean the group was still active and still had a name decades later.
